structure.heading: Communications, Training, and Adoption Measurement Plan Through Go-Live and Stabilization
text_content: **Communications, Training, and Adoption Measurement Plan Through Go-Live and Stabilization**

Communications will follow a phased, role-based plan coordinated by the NexusERP Communications Office to ensure clarity from pilot through stabilization. Messaging cadence: weekly pilot updates starting 2026-07-15, daily status during go-live week, and twice-weekly summaries during Hypercare. Channels include email newsletters, targeted Teams channels, digital signage in Plant A, and manager briefing packs. Key audiences are the 150 pilot users in Plant A, executive sponsors, operations leads, and IT support. Governance requires approval of all messages by Program Communications and Legal stakeholder liaison.

The training approach uses blended delivery to meet the 95% completion target by 2026-09-15, with role-based e-learning, instructor-led sessions, and on-the-job coaching. Course schedule requires pre-course e-learning completed seven days before role activation, two half-day instructor-led workshops during week two of team onboarding, and follow-up knowledge checks at 30 and 60 days. Training records are tracked in the LMS; compliance triggers escalation to managers at 80% completion and to HR if below 70% after remediation. Super-user certification and simulation labs validate applied skills.

Adoption measurement combines quantitative and qualitative KPIs monitored on a centralized dashboard maintained by Program Analytics. Core metrics include active user rate, task completion accuracy, time-to-complete key processes, support ticket volume and resolution time, Net Promoter Score collected at 30, 90, and 180 days. Baseline thresholds will be established from initial deployment data. Success thresholds include 90% task completion accuracy and a 25% reduction in support tickets by end of Hypercare; escalation protocols define corrective action when metrics miss targets rapidly with remediation.

7 support rotations staffed by Program Support, IT Operations, and Business Process Owners will cover the six-week Hypercare period from 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-12, with defined SLAs: 1 hour for Critical incidents, 4 hours for High, and 24 hours for Medium. Daily triage meetings, a single source of truth incident log, and a cadence of executive metrics reviews will ensure rapid containment, prioritized fixes, and a transition plan back to business-as-usual.

structure.heading: Stakeholder Impact and Readiness Assessment for the NexusERP Transformation
text_content: **Satkeholder Impact and Readiness Assessment for the NxeusERP Transformation**

Orion Manufacturing’s NexusERP transformation impacts 1,250 suers across three production sites: Plant A, Plant B, and Plant C. Stakeholder mapping identifies primary cohorts, including operations, inventory control, maintenance, finance, and plant leadership, each with distinct process dependencies. Role-based impact matrices will guide task reallocation, escalation paths, and system access changes to minimize disruption.

The readiness assessment establishes a baseline: readiness survey baseline is 58% favorable as of 2026-06-15. Analysis shows variation by function and plant, with operational users and frontline maintenance expressing the largest competency and confidence gaps. The assessment precsribes prioritized remediation steps, shorted timelines for hands-on practice, and governance checkpoints to raise favorable readiness ahead of cutover before go-live.
